The ledger disagreement WDP-P001-019 resolves as follows: the pinned SnCarrier is the restricted model (lift only on the five base shapes), the defects named in SnCarrierDischarge are witnessed on a definition local to that file (unconstrainedSectionLift) and on a separate inductive (UnrepairedCarrier), so both statements are about different objects. claim_boundary.supports: Kernel-checked for every glyph alphabet G, for a Lean restatement of the pinned restricted model (SnCarrier.lean sha256 357376de..., glyph alphabet abstracted, one-field wrappers flattened; clause-by-clause match with SnSyntax.lean and SnCarrierDischarge.unconstrainedSectionLift): the old-image law retr_n(sectionLift_n b) = accepted(b) for every base presentation at every stage, with an axiom report of propext only (the source old_image_base reports propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound, which was confirmed by compiling the pinned files); the lift is injective; the base type has 1 + g + 3 g^2 elements for g = |G| and the image of the lift has that cardinality at every stage; the unrestricted (pre-repair) lift is not injective, admits no recovery with the old-image law, and sends the refusal token to the ground presentation; the declared table carrierCard never equals the base cardinality at stages 0, 2 and 3, equals it at stage 1 only for the empty alphabet, and cannot match the per-shape counts g and g^2 at stages 1 and 2 together; the index-zero carrier is empty, which is definitional (the table entry carrierCard 0 = 0 is itself a declaration, the same theorem as the source ground_carrier_empty). The per-stage shape counts [1, g, g^2, 2g^2] and the cumulative counts [1, 1+g, 1+g+g^2, 1+g+3g^2] used in the comparison are native-only (not stated in Lean); the Lean comparison is with the stage-independent total. Native: six alphabet sizes (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6) with explicit universes of up to 2764 presentations are built and the pinned lift/retraction executed: the old-image law holds on every stage-base pair (0 failures), lift image sizes equal 1+g+3g^2, the unrestricted lift collapses every non-base presentation onto the ground lift, the table matches the stage shape counts [1, g, g^2, 2g^2] at stages 1 and 3 only for g = 1 (so at the pairs (g = 1, stage 1) and (g = 1, stage 3), and at no other (g, stage) pair for g in {0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6}), matches the cumulative counts nowhere except stage 1 of the empty alphabet, every stage guard is exact (S(S-1)|Base| mismatched-stage lifts refused) and glyph bodies of three or more glyphs are refused.
claim_boundary.does_not_support: A corrected cardinality theorem for the S(n) carriers: the table carrierCard remains a declared definition with no theorem relating Carrier n to the base presentations or the lift; off-image refusal completeness (node PG-SN-OFF-IMAGE-REFUSAL); nested lift, retraction or refusal terms as members of the base type; any theorem identifying the restatement with the pinned types at G = Glyph (36 letters and digits), and per-stage shape-count or cumulative-count statements in Lean (native-only); the real 36-glyph syntax beyond the instance baseCard 36 = 3925 and alphabets above six glyphs in the native certificate; wire parsing and the Python/Lean correspondence of the source; the locally defined UnrepairedCarrier of SnCarrierDischarge (a different type from Carrier); any physical, categorical or adjunction reading, including the string metadata of the custody-successor file mssn_functor_bridge.rs.
claim_boundary.narrowest_claim: For a Lean restatement of the pinned restricted S(n) model (SnCarrier.lean sha 357376de..., glyph alphabet abstracted, wrappers flattened), the base-presentation lift is injective with a left-inverse retraction at every stage and its image has 1+g+3g^2 points; the unrestricted lift has no recovery; the declared carrier table differs from the stage-independent base total 1+g+3g^2 at stages 0, 2 and 3 for every g (and at stage 1 unless g = 0), and no alphabet matches the per-shape counts g and g^2 at stages 1 and 2 together; the table is a declaration, not derived from the model.
claim_boundary.next_test: State and prove a corrected cardinality theorem: define Carrier n from the lift image or the stage-n shape set over the 36-glyph alphabet, prove its cardinality for n = 0..3 including the ground token, and decide whether carrierCard equals that derived function or must be replaced by it.

second_review.notes: Cold read of run 20261021T132245Z_staged. Lean (lean4/SnCarrierPfp.lean, sha f55efb45..., byte-identical to p1/construction; recompiled, no sorry): old_image_base, sectionLift_injective, unrestricted_lift_not_injective, no_recovery_for_unrestricted_lift, refusal_token_round_trip_changes_input, baseCard_36 are propext only, ground_carrier_empty axiom-free, card_base/card_image_sectionLift/table_ne_base_stage_two/three/one_iff use Classical.choice (via Fintype), so the supports sentence 'axiom report of propext only' is correct for the old-image law and must stay scoped to it. I compared the restatement with the originals myself: SnCarrier.lean (input, sha 357376de..., matches the pin) and, outside the run, SnSyntax.lean (sha fe6292be..., equals the README sha) and SnCarrierDischarge.unconstrainedSectionLift (001_sn_mssn/lean4/SnCarrierDischarge.lean, sha 875af3a5...): Pres/Base/Rel/Body mirror SnPresentation/BasePresentation/RelationToken/InnerBody with the 36-glyph type abstracted and one-field wrappers flattened; sectionLift and retr match clause by clause, including the stage guard and the fall-through of glyph lists of length >= 3 to nonDescent; unrestrictedLift matches the fallthrough '_ => lift stage (glyphs [])'. I also checked the source axiom_report (line 3280): SnTheorems.old_image_base is [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext], so the claim about the source proof is right and the restatement only shows it is not needed for the restatement. Anchors say what is claimed: card_base is Fintype.card (Base G) = 1 + g + 3 g^2 through an explicit Equiv with one Unit, one G and three G x G summands; card_image_sectionLift is stage independent; table_ne_base_stage_zero/two/three and table_eq_base_stage_one_iff compare carrierCard n with the stage-INDEPENDENT total baseCard g; no_alphabet_matches_stages_one_two says not (g = carrierCard 1 and g^2 = carrierCard 2). Earlier amendments: restatement wording ('Lean restatement of the pinned restricted model') applied in supports and narrowest_claim; the false 'equals no stage-wise count' sentence replaced by the correct stage-independent comparison; ground_carrier_empty flagged definitional; does_not_support now names the missing identification at G = Glyph and the native-only shape/cumulative counts; mutants for cumulative counts, mismatched stage, long glyph body and the empty-alphabet coincidence added (11 semantic mutants, 440 coordinate mutants, all rejected, control accepted). No weakened check from the rebuild. What the earlier pass missed or only half-said: (1) The native per-stage shape counts [1, g, g^2, 2 g^2] (checker and producer both hard-code stage_shapes) assume the directed cut belongs to stage 3 with the 1-simplex. SnSyntax.lean labels only 'Stage S(2): retained pair' and 'Stage S(3): abstract 1-simplex cut' and says the relational tokens cover S(2) and S(3); the directed cut carries no stage label. So the native statement 'the table matches the stage shape counts at stages 1 and 3 only for g = 1' (and the mutant table_matches_pair_count_at_one_glyph, which flips table_matches[2]) rest on an unsourced assignment shared by producer and checker; with cut at stage 2 the counts would be [1, g, 2 g^2, g^2] and the g = 1 coincidence at stage 3 disappears. It is native-only and disclosed as native, so not a defect, but the supports text should name the assignment. (2) Custody: the comparison sources SnSyntax.lean and SnCarrierDischarge.lean (and SnOffImage.lean, which the README says was read) are not among run inputs or source_pins; only SnCarrier.lean and SnTheorems.lean are pinned. The 'clause-by-clause match' therefore cannot be reproduced from the sealed run; I could, from the external checkout, and it holds. (3) The README sentence 'they differ from the cardinality the model has' overreaches: the model has no stage-n carrier; what is shown is inequality with the stage-independent base total (and with native per-stage shape counts), and the source itself says carrierCard is 'declared for finite examples; not source-derived stage counts', so nobody advertised equality with these numbers. The finding is non-derivability, not a refutation, and the DAG text must be phrased that way. (4) The README resolution of ledger row WDP-P001-019 (restricted pinned lift vs unconstrainedSectionLift vs UnrepairedCarrier) is a reading of files, not a kernel statement; the ledger row itself (paper_claim_ledger.md:25) is not in the run inputs, and UnrepairedCarrier is not modelled in Lean (does_not_support says so). (5) Finite-universe quantities (universe_size, unrestricted_image_size, unrestricted_fibre_over_ground, long_body_refused) depend on the truncation maxlen of glyph-list bodies and are descriptions of a truncated universe; the Lean non-injectivity is the content. Checker: independent in representation (wire strings of the source grammar and a regex retraction parser vs tuple match), recomputes the full universe, image sizes, fibres, stage-mismatch refusals (S(S-1)|Base|) and long-body refusals; hard-codes only TABLE (the declared source table), the shape-count vector (see 1) and closed-form cumulative counts. Mutants are mostly leaf edits (table_matches, fibre counts); ledger_defect_read_as_restricted_failure, unrestricted_lift_has_recovery, refusal_token_recovered and lift_image_shrinks_with_stage are the genuinely informative near misses; ground_presentation_counted_as_carrier is a flag the checker forbids by an explicit rule. next_test (define Carrier n from the lift image or stage-n shape set and decide whether carrierCard equals it) is the node's own obligation and is a restatement of the first does_not_support clause as an action; acceptable.

earlier_pass.notes: Statement fidelity (lean4/SnCarrierPfp.lean; the p2 log shows old_image_base, sectionLift_injective and unrestricted_* on propext only, card theorems on propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound): I compared the restatement with the pinned SnCarrier.lean and with SnSyntax.lean (SnSyntax is NOT in the run inputs; I read it in the_symbol_game/omega_engine_education/documentation/002_oesn/lean4). Pres/Base/Rel/Body mirror SnPresentation/BasePresentation/RelationToken/InnerBody with the glyph type abstracted and one-field wrappers flattened; sectionLift and retr match the source clause by clause, including the stage guard and the 'glyph list of length >= 3 -> nonDescent' fallthrough; unrestrictedLift matches SnCarrierDischarge.unconstrainedSectionLift. The general anchors state what is claimed: old_image_base is r_n(u_n b) = accepted(b.toPres) for all n and b; sectionLift_injective follows from it; card_base and card_image_sectionLift give 1 + g + 3 g^2 (baseEquiv has one Unit, one G and three G x G summands); unrestricted_lift_not_injective is the ground/nonDescent collision; no_recovery_for_unrestricted_lift quantifies over every recovery r into Pres G (+) E. Weaker than described: (1) ground_carrier_empty is Fin.elim0 on the table entry carrierCard 0 = 0, which is itself a declaration, so it is definitional, not evidence about S(0); it is the same theorem as the source's ground_carrier_empty. (2) The table-vs-count anchors compare carrierCard n with the stage-INDEPENDENT total baseCard g (table_ne_base_stage_*), plus the per-shape pair (g = carrierCard 1 and g^2 = carrierCard 2). The per-stage shape counts [1, g, g^2, 2 g^2] used by the producer/checker (and quoted in supports) are the producer's own stage assignment (stage 3 = cut + simplex) and nothing in Lean states them, so there is no kernel theorem for stages 0 and 3 against per-shape counts, nor for cumulative counts [1, 1+g, 1+g+g^2, 1+g+3g^2]. (3) 'equals no stage-wise presentation count' in narrowest_claim is false as written for g = 1: native table_matches is true at stages 1 and 3 for g = 1 (the same supports paragraph says so, and mutant table_matches_pair_count_at_one_glyph relies on it). What is shown: the table differs from the base total for every g at stages 0, 2, 3 (and at stage 1 unless g = 0), and no g matches stages 1 and 2 per-shape. (4) The comparison itself is mild: the source declares carrierCard 'for finite examples; not source-derived stage counts', so nobody advertises equality with these counts; the finding is that the table is not derivable from the model, which is correct but should not be phrased as a refutation. (5) The Lean module is a restatement over abstract G; no theorem identifies it with the pinned types at G = Glyph (36 letters and digits). narrowest_claim says 'the pinned restricted S(n) model'; it should say 'a restatement of'. The axiom comparison (propext only versus the source's Classical.choice) does not discharge the source's Classical.choice for the source theorem; it shows the restatement does not need it. Overclaim: see (3) and (5). does_not_support names the right unpaid items (corrected cardinality theorem, off-image refusal) and also lists wire parsing and the Python/Lean correspondence. Checker: independent in representation (wire strings plus a regex retraction parser versus tuples) and closed forms in g; the full universe is enumerated and fibre/image sizes recomputed. The unrestricted fibre, universe size and image size depend on the truncation maxlen of glyph-list bodies and are finite-universe descriptions only; the real content is the Lean non-injectivity. Not exercised natively or by any mutant: the stage guard (retraction at a mismatched stage returns nonDescent; source descent_refusal_on_mismatched_stage) and the length >= 3 glyph body refusal; supports does not claim them, but the certificate cannot catch a regression there. Cases are six alphabet sizes (0..6 glyphs). Mutants: unrestricted_lift_has_recovery, refusal_token_recovered, lift_image_shrinks_with_stage, table_matches_pair_count_at_one_glyph and ledger_defect_read_as_restricted_failure are real near misses to stated bridges (the last one is exactly the confusion about WDP-P001-019 that the node resolves). ground_presentation_counted_as_carrier is a flag flip that the checker already forbids in code (require table_matches[0] is False). Missing: table compared with cumulative stage counts; a retraction that accepts a mismatched stage; the empty-alphabet degenerate case where table equals the base total at stage 1 being read as general. next_test: its own obligation, but it restates the first does_not_support clause as an action ('a corrected cardinality theorem'); accepted, though the real deliverable is defining Carrier n from the lift image, with 'decide whether carrierCard equals it' as a follow-up. DAG: PG-SN-CARRIER is PROVED_LEAN; the node statement describes the base presentation, section lift, retraction outcome, empty ground carrier and old_image_base, plus the ledger conflict WDP-P001-019. The result resolves the conflict (restricted pinned SnCarrier satisfies the law; the defects are on a local unconstrained lift and a separate inductive) and shows the advertised cardinality table is not a consequence of the model. Status need not be lowered; the statement should be narrowed and the cardinality part flagged open.
